text:
dmitri: Heads up — Nexa flagged temperature sensitivity on the latest H200 shipment. They ran burn-in and ~4% of units tripped thermal warnings at 85°C. Holding US-EAST pool for now.

maria_p: ugh. which serials? can we use spares for prod? :worried:

dmitri: sampled serials: NEXA-H200-000112..000160 (12 units failed out of 288 tested). failures are inconsistent, some pass then fail after 30m stress.

nexa_supply_ops: confirmed. root cause looks like borderline heatsink seating + coolant prefill variance. vendor offered two pathways: expedited warranty swap for failed units (ETA 8–12 days) or immediate partial credit (2%) and send tech-rework kits to depots.

kevin_ops: 2% credit doesn't cut it for EU workloads — our burn rate there will be impacted. what's cost to ship tech kits vs full replacement?

nexa_supply_ops: tech kit per-unit freight+kit ~ $1200, labor assumed at customer site. Full replacement (air) per unit incremental ~$9.2k.

anna_sales: we need a clear customer-facing plan. if EU customers see degraded perf, escalation. recommend we hold EU allocations and route US traffic to spare pool. :point_up:

procurement-bot: Automated note: PO# 57821 allocation impacted. Vendor proposal logged under ticket NX-644.

maria_p: operational proposal: 1) quarantine suspect batch at EU crossdock, 2) push spares from US buffer to EU for next 7 days, 3) open RMA for failed serials (batch RMA), 4) ask vendor for 5% credit + free tech kits to cover on-site rework.

dmitri: agree on quarantine and buffer swap. can logistics handle crossdock move and customs hold?

logistics-bot: Suggested move: create crossdock order CD-2026-77 -> ETA EU-AMS 72h. Requires temporary HS code amendment for repair parts.

kevin_ops: created quick check script, please run on a failing unit before shipping back:
```
# quick thermal burn
stress-test --duration 45m --load 0.95 --log /tmp/therm.log
grep "thermal_trip" /tmp/therm.log | tail -n 5
```

maria_p: nice. we should also capture KV cache retention test since these are inference nodes. subtle thermal throttles cause tail-latency spikes.

dmitri: vendor counter-offer in the call: 4% credit if we accept depot-level rework only (no full swap), or they will expedite 50% of replacements within 6 days at 3% credit. they want RMA labels created tonight.

anna_sales: prioritize customer SLAs > credit %. if we can get 50% replacements in 6 days for critical customers, accept and escalate for EU.

kevin_ops: technical ask: include preflight perf verification at vendor depot and require per-serial bench logs before shipback. add `bench_id` and `therm_profile` to RMA metadata.

procurement-bot: Action item created: RMA request draft (RMA-2026-5892). Draft includes fields: unit_count=12, desired_credit=5%, requested_preflight=true.

nexa_supply_ops: we'll accept depot-level rework + preflight logs. final commercial offer: 3.5% credit if we accept depot rework + vendor covers return freight for failed units. Replacement ETA for the 50% expedited slice = 6 days; remainder via standard lead time 14–18 days.

maria_p: counter: we need 4.5% credit + vendor-covered return freight + on-site rework kits for EU crossdock for 20 units. otherwise we escalate to legal.

dmitri: ok let's not escalate yet. maria, can you draft the concession and tag legal if vendor doesn't budge by EOD?

maria_p: on it. tagging @anna_sales for customer comms once we sign.

anna_sales: will prep a short template: "temporary hold on EU deployments — using US buffer, replacements in progress". want to keep tone calm.

kevin_ops: Ops checklist for today: 1) run `stress-test` on 24 random units, 2) snapshot KV cache test, 3) label suspect units with `rma-suspect` tag, 4) create crossdock order. I can own steps 1–3.

logistics-bot: Crossdock order CD-2026-77 created, provisional clearance submitted. Awaiting vendor pickup slot confirmation.

procurement-bot: Reminder: attach original invoices to RMA ticket to enable credit reconciliation.

dmitri: final note — we want vendor to commit to per-serial perf logs and a temporary SLA: replacements for any unit that fails preflight at depot within 3 days of receipt. include that in the agreement or we escalate.

nexa_supply_ops: understood. we'll push updated commercial terms and preflight spec within 4 hours.

maria_p: good. if vendor signs, proceed with partial expedited replacements and ship tech kits to EU crossdock same-day.

kevin_ops: thanks all — I'll post quick logs once first 8 stress tests finish. :rocket:
